translations.web: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
translations.bsb: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.
